correctness.rationale: For g=I+N in characteristic two, g²=I+N² and derived UT5 group has six entries at distance>=2. Multiplying N gives u=ab,v=bc,w=cd,r=af+ec,s=bg+fd,t=ai+eg+hd. If v=0 then uw=0; if v≠0 and u=w=0 then vt=rs. The explicit algebraic choices for each of the complementary cases solve all six equations and establish sufficiency for arbitrary fields of characteristic two. Disjoint counting yields |S|=q^6-q^5+q^4+q^3-q^2. Independent exhaustive enumeration over 2^9 and 4^9 relevant N-parameters gives respectively 52 and 3376 images and agrees target-by-target with criterion. Same Jordan type opposite square status follows directly from the equations and explicit root; finite checks support but do not prove all q.
